purpose: Test whether exact parameter interpolation moves the verified r96 parent toward I-23's material behavior without the failed I-30 residual-training dynamics. This development probe is not an online-score estimate and cannot authorize a package.

development_holdout.role: Development only because it has already been inspected for I-30. It must not be reused as an I-31 acceptance set.

advance_rule: Advance only if at least one frozen lambda improves both material directions versus r96, has non-positive candidate-to-I23 KL delta in both directions, and shows a materially better retention tradeoff than I-30. If so, build a new prompt-disjoint acceptance holdout before packaging. Otherwise close I-31 without a package.
forbidden: No lambda additions or midpoint search after seeing this probe
No package or online upload from the development probe
No claim that development metrics estimate online score
